mechanism: Diclofenac reduces renal perfusion and sodium excretion while chlorthalidone causes volume depletion and electrolyte loss, synergistically increasing risk of acute kidney injury, hyperkalemia, and reduced antihypertensive efficacy.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; consider alternative analgesia or use lowest effective diclofenac dose with adequate hydration; ensure regular blood pressure monitoring.
